What's in it for you:
 
▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions. 
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team. 
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance. 
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success. 
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth. 
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team. 
 
About Caseware:
Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
 
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
 
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at talent@caseware.com.
 
Background Check:
Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co 
 
Security and Fraud:
Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website https://jobs.lever.co/caseware. We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. If you receive an unsolicited job offer, proceed with extreme caution.

payload.descriptionPlain:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!


As an Account Executive SMB Firms at Caseware, your goal will be to drive new, upsell and cross-sell sales of Caseware’sproduct suite with a focus on small and medium-sized clients within our US market. 
 
Your role will be focused on sales within the firm market segment and will be primarily selling our OnPoint suite of products to small firms and sole proprietors. This is a massive opportunity because our research is showing 100,000+ sole proprietors in the US market alone, and with our recent strategic partnership with CPA.com we expect huge support in marketing. 
 
We are going through a build-up of our Sales organization, and you will be a founding member of the future of Sales Operations at Caseware. If are a Sales Professional with a hunter-mentality and going after new business is something that inspires you, we want to hear from you! (This role will be 50/50 split between inbound & outbound activities). This role would be perfect for you if you are success-driven, achievement-oriented, love sales, and believe in performance rewards for exceeding sales goals.  
 
 This role is remote and is open to all candidates who reside and are eligible to work in US (preferably on the East coast).
 
❗Note, a successful candidate will work in North American time zones - EST, MT, PST (The time zone is TBD depending on the territory assigned).

• Using prospecting solutions like ZoomInfo and LinkedIn to generate leads within a defined territory and region. 
  • Using sales and marketing assets to create email campaigns  
  • Given a list of contacts generated by marketing as well as existing inbound leads, contact our customers, address their needs, and introduce them to the full scope of the CaseWare product suite 
  • Qualifying inbound and outbound activities (calls and emails) 
  • Quickly and effectively establish key relationships with decision-makers within  sole practitioners to small firms 
  • Providing prospects with high-level solution overviews when required 
  • Provide advice and value guidance to CaseWare prospects maximizing opportunities to build and accelerate revenue 
  • Monitor sales goal set by CaseWare to increase product revenue 
  • Drive the business growth - meet and exceed monthly/quarterly revenue targets by prospecting, securing meetings, and closing new business 
  • Create and execute action plans to engage appropriate CaseWare cross-functional resources to contribute to sales and development strategy 
  • Assisting with marketing automation 
  • Other duties as required

• 1+ years of experience in tech sales or in a comparable customer-facing role, ideally SaaS Sales (understanding and selling accounting software is a strong asset) 
  • Ability to query various sources such as Hubspot, Salesforce, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Nav to identify opportunities  
  • Self-discipline, GSD mentality, and a strong desire to succeed 
  • Record of consistent achievement of goals 
  • A foundational understanding of technology sales, forecasting, and lead development processes 
  • A foundational understanding of accounting and financial processes and technologies 
  • Experience or understanding of sales, campaign, and marketing automation solutions 
  • Prior experience in inside sales, account management, client success, or client services  
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritize a high volume of daily tasks and leads   
  • Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders 
  • Excellent discovery, listening and presentation abilities 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills 
  • Experience mapping customer requirements, needs and goals to solution capabilities, benefits and outcomes  
  • Experience with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) 
  • Bachelor's degree in sales, business management, accounting, finance, or a related field 
  • Prior work in the audit and accounting technology industry is a plus

payload.additionalPlain:
Was wir Dir bieten:
• Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.
 • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
 • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg.
 • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.
 • Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung.
 • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards.

Über Caseware:
Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Mit der Investition von Hg Capital im Jahr 2020 haben wir eine wichtige Wachstumsphase begonnen, in der wir konsequent in Menschen, Produkte und Strukturen investieren. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt sind uns wichtig. Wir möchten Teams aufbauen, die unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven einbringen. Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung benötigst, kannst du uns jederzeit unter talent@caseware.com kontaktieren.

Sicherheitshinweis:
Kommunikation von Caseware erfolgt ausschließlich über E-Mail-Adressen, die auf @caseware.com enden. Alle offenen Stellen findest du auf anerkannten Jobportalen und unter
https://jobs.lever.co/caseware
Wir fragen niemals nach Zahlungen oder finanziellen Angaben. Wenn dir ein verdächtiges Angebot zugesendet wird, sei vorsichtig.

payload.descriptionPlain:
Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.


Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften.
📍Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell.

lists.content:
• Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst.

  • Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust.

  • Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen.

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen.

  • Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind.

• Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen.

  • Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften.

  • Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen.

  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth. 
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team. 
 
About Caseware:
Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
 
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
 
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at talent@caseware.com.
 
Background Check:
Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co 
 
Security and Fraud:
Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website https://jobs.lever.co/caseware. We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. If you receive an unsolicited job offer, proceed with extreme caution.

lists.content:
• Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision. 

  • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration. 

  • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap. 

  • Balance delivery speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health when making technical decisions. 

  • Break down large initiatives into parallelizable chunks of work that deliver incremental business value. 

  • Champion proposals through all phases of the SDLC, from design through production implementation. 

  • Contribute to improving the core product build, CI/CD pipelines, and overall SDLC. 

  • Troubleshoot and eliminate root causes of persistent production issues; drive reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response. 

  • Keep technical documentation current and create new artifacts as needed. 

  • Facilitate design discussions within and across teams. 

  • Represent the team in technical discussions with Tech Leads, Operations, Product/UX, Security, Domain SMEs, and external stakeholders. 

  • Act as a trusted technical leader, helping teams succeed through collaboration, influence, and shared ownership. 

  • Mentor other developers through design reviews, joint agentic-AI sessions, and feedback on skills, prompts, and other agent inputs; contribute to raising overall engineering maturity. 

  • Share knowledge of new technologies and industry best practices. 

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and cloud capabilities that could benefit the platform.

• Use AI-assisted development tools — inline completion, conversational assistants, and agentic workflows — as a standard part of your daily workflow.  

  • Critically evaluate and take ownership of all AI-generated output before it ships — verify correctness, security, and alignment with architecture and team standards.  

  • Identify opportunities for agentic automation within your team, and lead the rollout of new AI-assisted workflows and tooling.  

  • Mentor other developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.  

  • Help establish team-level practices and guardrails for using AI tools safely and effectively.  

  • Build and refine feedback loops that improve the team's collective use of AI tooling over time.

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated impact beyond a single team. 

  • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS. 

  • Strong software fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and a track record of advocating for code quality. 

  • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices. 

  • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar). 

  • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams. 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. English high B2. 

  • Strong initiative to improve processes, tools, methodologies, and product quality.

• Build and operate the AWS AgentCore Gateway layer and the capabilities it hosts — MCP tool targets today, extending to inbound access, agent-to-agent (HTTP) targets, and inference/model-routing targets as those capabilities come online. 

  • Develop and maintain the target registry and configuration model that lets customer firms register their own MCP servers for their agents to call, covering tenant isolation, credential handling, allowlisting and egress control, and containment when a third-party endpoint fails or misbehaves. 

  • Build the inbound surface that exposes Caseware capability to external agents and clients over MCP and adjacent protocols, including authentication, scope enforcement, and rate limiting. 

  • Build and operate the on-premise connectivity path, including session lifecycle, request correlation, and recovery for long-lived sessions between cloud-hosted agents and on-premise desktop clients. 

  • Implement session and scope propagation from agent to gateway to target to backend, so authorization is correct and auditable at every hop. 

  • Design and evolve OpenAPI contracts for gateway targets, and the target runtimes that implement them, keeping conventions consistent regardless of what a target fronts. 

  • Implement outbound authorization for gateway targets (IAM/SigV4, OAuth, credential providers) so access to each target type is securely and consistently controlled. 

  • Maintain versioning of target contracts as they evolve, so consuming teams and customers are not broken by change. 

  • Contribute to end-to-end tracing and SLOs for gateway traffic, and build the observability that lets you and other teams detect and debug failures anywhere in the pipeline. 

  • Mentor other developers joining the team, and contribute to technical direction for the integration layer through RFCs and design reviews.

• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for LLM agents. 

  • Experience building or operating a multi-tenant gateway or API platform: several traffic patterns behind one access point, tenant isolation, per-tenant credentials and secrets, quotas, and abuse protection. 

  • Experience integrating with third-party or untrusted endpoints, with a clear point of view on failure containment and limiting blast radius. 

  • Experience with authorization and scope propagation across multi-hop service boundaries — carrying and checking identity and permissions through the full pipeline, not just authenticating once. 

  • Experience designing and operating persistent-connection or streaming architectures, including session management, recovery, and message correlation, along with related protocol-level concerns (timeout/retry semantics, backpressure, idempotency, graceful degradation).

• Experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, or other managed agent/LLM orchestration platforms. 

  • Experience with LLM provider routing and gateway patterns (multi-provider endpoints, model-based routing) or agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols. 

  • Experience building developer- or partner-facing platform surfaces that external parties integrate against. 

  • Experience integrating cloud services with on-premise or embedded clients (webviews, desktop apps). 

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform). 

  • Experience operating systems in regulated or compliance-heavy domains.

• Backend & Platform: Node.js/TypeScript 

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Lambda, AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore Gateway (or similar third-party platforms/tools) 

  • Connectivity: Persistent-connection relay architecture for on-premise integrations 

  • Contracts & Protocols: OpenAPI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), A2UI 

  • Developer Tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions

• ¨Contrato a termino Indefinido¨ with all the legal benefits
  • Prepaid Medicine
  • Life insurance and funeral assistance
  • Internet allowance
  • Home office stipend
  • Competitive compensation — above the market average
  • 100% remote work environment and an excellent work-life balance
  • Opportunity to work for a growing global SaaS leader company
  • A culture that promotes independence, innovation, trust, and accountability
  • Open space to be creative, innovative and strategize for the future
  • Mentorship by highly experienced professional 
  • Budget for training, we want you to grow
  • 5 Personal Time Off days per year
  • Sick Leave Top up to total 100% of salary paid by the employer from Day 3 to 90. 
  • Recognition Award, additional paid time off in recognition of the corresponding year of service
  • Upgrade vacation starting at 5 years of service
  • AI-first environment: Be part of an AI-first engineering organization that embraces modern tools, automation, and AI-driven ways of working.
